harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (RHEL 9.8) to boot with audit=1 persistently via grubby (BLS entries), verified with a full reboot cycle that the kernel cmdline includes audit=1 and auditd is active post-reboot.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: /proc/cmdline lacked audit=1; boot_id fbdf5b2c...; auditd active
Ran `sudo grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1"` to persist the parameter for all BLS boot entries (normal + rescue kernel)
Verified /boot/loader/entries/*.conf for both kernels now contain audit=1 in options
Scheduled and executed a safe self-reboot via systemd-run (ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming new boot_id 720242bf... (changed from fbdf5b2c...) and fresh uptime timestamp
Post-reboot verified /proc/cmdline contains audit=1, auditd is active, and auditctl -s reports enabled 1

evidence.summary: Pre-change /proc/cmdline (no audit=1), boot_id fbdf5b2c..., auditd active, grubby present with two boot entries

evidence.requirement: Persist audit=1 across reboots via grubby/BLS
evidence.summary: grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args=audit=1 applied; verified BLS entries /boot/loader/entries/*.conf for both normal and rescue kernels contain audit=1
systemd-run scheduled a 1s-delayed systemctl reboot; command returned 'scheduled' before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Proof of actual restart / changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Exec stream closed mid-command as reboot began, followed by connection timeouts while node was down, then successful reconnection with new boot_id 720242bf-... (changed from fbdf5b2c-...) and fresh uptime -s timestamp matching reboot time

evidence.requirement: Post-restart proof audit=1 is active and auditd healthy
evidence.summary: Post-reboot /proc/cmdline includes audit=1, systemctl is-active auditd returns active, auditctl -s reports enabled 1

attempts.summary: Configured node1 (RHEL 9.8) to boot with audit=1 persistently via grubby (BLS entries), verified with a full reboot cycle that the kernel cmdline includes audit=1 and auditd is active post-reboot.
